name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_add_bitmap_entry
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::AddBitmapEntry grows item/visible counts when needed, skips entries beyond visibleCount, allocates a HudUiWidget in entriesB, applies an owned image path, positions it, hides it, and attaches it to the owner container.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiCycleSelectorWidget source-cluster pass.
The image-path loading branch is accepted through HudUiWidget::SetImageByPathOwned dependency coverage; this focused smoke uses a null image path to avoid opening retail texture archives.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b8200 validates the itemCount/visibleCount growth and clamp, visibleCount guard, HudUiWidget allocation/construction, entriesB[index] assignment, SetImageByPathOwned call, SetPos and SetVisible(0) dispatch, and HudUiContainer::AddChild call.

Native smoke zhud_cycle_selector_widget_constructor_smoke verifies the grow/add branch creates a hidden HudUiWidget child at the requested position and verifies the index-greater-than-visibleCount branch leaves the existing entry and counts unchanged.
